desk.headline: Not a results release: Banco Macro bought back 430,000 of its own shares for about Ps$3.98bn; no guidance
results: This 24 Nov filing is not a results release: it reports a share buyback to Argentina's securities regulator (CNV).
Banco Macro bought 430,000 Class B shares at an average Ps$9,251.32, about Ps$3.98bn in total.
The filing has no profit, revenue or loan figures for the September quarter.

guidance.summary: This filing gives no financial guidance.

call.source: No call coverage found: routine buyback notice (Form 6-K)

watch: The September-quarter results release, once filed.
